notes: Read the line-numbered source before editing; every one of the 221 source lines was considered. Imports (L1-5): react hooks kept (useCallback/useEffect/useRef/useState) plus useMemo added for the dropdown anchor position; react-i18next useTranslation (L2) replaced by a native-safe useNativeTranslationFallback returning t(key, fallback, params?) that interpolates i18next-style {{count}} placeholders (preserves every translation key + i18n intent); lucide-react Download/FileJson/FileSpreadsheet (L3) rendered via the existing SemanticIcon (download/fileJson/fileSpreadsheet, decorative); the web @/components/ui Button (L4) replaced by a token-styled Pressable; cn (L5) replaced by StyleSheet (no className concatenation on native).

ListExportMenuProps (L7-24) preserved verbatim incl. JSDoc: onExportCsv/onExportJson (scope) => void | Promise<void>, selectedCount?, visibleCount?, disabled?, className?, testId?. className keeps its slot for source compatibility but is ignored on native (destructured as _className); testId maps to RN testID. ExportScope type (L26) preserved verbatim ('visible' | 'selected'). The L28-44 component doc comment is preserved/expanded in the file header, plus a per-component doc above ListExportMenu.

Component signature + defaults (L45-53) preserved: selectedCount = 0, disabled = false destructured defaults identical. useTranslation() (L54) -> const t = useNativeTranslationFallback(). open useState(false) (L55) and scope useState (L56-58, initialised selectedCount > 0 ? 'selected' : 'visible') preserved with identical names + logic. containerRef (L59, HTMLDivElement) -> triggerRef (View): the web ref existed ONLY for the mousedown click-outside hit-test (now handled by the Modal backdrop), so on native it instead measures the trigger to anchor the dropdown. close useCallback (L61) preserved verbatim.

Click-outside + Escape effect (L63-77, document.addEventListener mousedown/keydown): React Native has no document, so this is replaced by the <Modal> primitive — a full-screen backdrop Pressable (onPress=close) is the click-outside analog, and Modal onRequestClose=close is the Android-back analog of the Escape key. The selection snap-back effect (L79-83: if selectedCount===0 && scope==='selected' setScope('visible')) is ported verbatim as a useEffect with the same [selectedCount, scope] deps and comment.

Labels (L85-94) ported verbatim through native t(): triggerLabel (L85-87 disabled ? listExport.disabledTooltip 'No data to export' : listExport.menuLabel 'Export list'), visibleLabel (L89-91 visibleCount != null ? listExport.visibleWithCount 'Visible ({{count}})' : listExport.visible 'Visible'), selectedLabel (L92-94 listExport.selectedWithCount 'Selected ({{count}})'). handleCsv (L96-99) and handleJson (L100-103) preserved verbatim incl. deps: each calls close() then void onExport*(scope).

Render root (L105-110): the relative <div ref data-testid> becomes a <View testID> with position:'relative'. Trigger (L111-128): the web Button (ghost, sm, Download icon, aria-haspopup/aria-expanded/aria-label/title, onClick toggling open) becomes a Pressable with ref=triggerRef, accessibilityRole='button', accessibilityState={{disabled, expanded: open}} (aria-expanded), accessibilityLabel=triggerLabel (aria-label + title; RN has no tooltip), disabled, a decorative SemanticIcon 'download', and the 'Export' AppText (web L125-127 'hidden sm:inline' responsive label is shown on native for context/a11y — documented reduction). onClick setOpen toggle -> toggle() which also measureInWindow()s the trigger to anchor the dropdown; disabled short-circuits the toggle so the menu never opens when disabled (mirrors web {open && !disabled}).

Dropdown (L129-191): the conditionally-rendered absolutely-positioned <div role='menu'> is rendered inside a transparent <Modal visible={open && !disabled}> so it floats above the screen with proper outside-tap + back handling. The menu View carries accessibilityRole='menu', accessibilityLabel=triggerLabel (aria-label), accessibilityViewIsModal, and is positioned via measured anchor (web 'absolute right-0 mt-1 w-56' = right-aligned, 4px below, 224px wide; a top-right fallback is used when measurement is unavailable, e.g. headless tests). The fieldset scope block (L139-161, gated on selectedCount > 0) becomes a View with the ListChecks legend marker (no SemanticIcon name exists, so a decorative '\u2611' AppText glyph carries the visual; the 'Export scope' caption carries the meaning) plus two ScopeRadio rows wired to setScope('visible')/setScope('selected') with the same testIds.

CSV/JSON menu items (L162-189): each <button type=button role=menuitem onClick data-testid> becomes a Pressable accessibilityRole='menuitem' onPress={handleCsv|handleJson} testID, with a decorative SemanticIcon (fileSpreadsheet/fileJson) and the translated label (listExport.csv 'Download as CSV', listExport.json 'Download as JSON'). hover:bg/focus-visible:bg states map to a pressed background. ScopeRadioProps (L196-201) and ScopeRadio (L203-221) ported: the <label><input type=radio accent-blue-500> becomes a Pressable accessibilityRole='radio' accessibilityState={{checked}} accessibilityLabel=label onPress=onChange testID, with a custom circular dot indicator (accent token) replacing the native radio input and an AppText label.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported — only React, react-native primitives (Modal/Pressable/StyleSheet/View), the existing native SemanticIcon + AppText, and theme tokens (colors/spacing). All Tailwind/CSS-var classes are reproduced with StyleSheet + tokens (text-secondary/primary/muted, surface-elevated, border-white, shadow-xl, w-56, rounded-lg). Behavior verified by __tests__/ListExportMenu.test.tsx (6 tests: open->CSV visible scope, selected-default JSON export, scope-radio switch, mid-menu snap-back to visible, disabled no-op, disabled a11y label/state). Gates: npm run typecheck PASS, npm run lint -- --quiet PASS, npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles PASS (18 suites / 83 tests).
